prompt.note: Positive prompt for both passes (LTXVConditioning 107 feeds the base sampler 113 and, through LTXVCropGuides 102, the spatial-upscale sampler 119). Text-to-video only: there is no LoadImage in this graph.

seed.note: Base pass. The spatial-upscale pass RandomNoise 114 keeps its own seed (0, fixed).

video.note: Upscaled video with the LTX audio track (VAEDecodeTiled 126 + LTXVAudioVAEDecode 127). save_output is false in the shipped file, so the mp4 lands in ComfyUI temp/; set widgets_values.save_output to true for a file in output/.

notes: Length: PrimitiveInt 112 'Length' widget 0 is a frame count (240 at PrimitiveInt 137 frame rate 24 = 10 s). The studio `seconds` parameter is not bound because the widget wants frames; set 24 * seconds + 1 by hand.
Resolution: EmptyImage 111 (720x1280) scaled by 0.5 in ImageScaleBy 104 sets the base size (GetImageSize 105); the LTXVLatentUpsampler 118 pass doubles it with ltx-2-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.0.
Models: ltx-2-19b-dev-fp8 checkpoint (130) with the ltx-2-19b-distilled-lora-384 LoRA (131, 141); gemma_3_12B_it text encoder (99). The camera-control dolly LoRAs 132 and 133 are bypassed.
No batch count: one video per run.
The shipped prompt (121) and negative (110) are the creator's demo text; the studio prompt replaces both.
